cards.words_note: Typed text jumps straight to Song Number 3: the SET LIST 22 header, Song Number 1 TONY'S SONG (photo 2) and Song Number 2 LOVE AND MY HAND (photo 9) are not in the typed part shown (text is cut at 1800, but order says they were skipped). Kill the Seed is badly misread: most lines wrong ('They say to go in the news' = 'Don't go in the ocean', 'A dead summer is a new sharp paragraph' = 'A death sentence is now thirty paragraphs') and the verse 'There's bugs in all our devices...entering our heads!' is missing. Headers misread (798,14f should be 789,14b; Song 4 798 should be 790). Handwritten note: 'worry you' should be 'warn ya', and it is below Kill the Seed in marker, not top-left pencil. Thinking Gets Risky has several misread lines ('this out like a muthafuchin squirm' = 'this nut like a muthafuckin squirrel', 'Get sweaty' = 'Get honey', 'milk the stump' line wrong).
